title: MZ Trying to code compare & counters for mini-game

posts.author: Elith
Robro33
posts.body:
Elith said:
$gameVariables.setValue(3,++);
Click to expand...
++ and -- by themselves arent values, so the game is still looking for one after it and crashes when it gets to the closing parenthesis.
if you want to increase and decrease a game variable by 1, then calling the value function within the setValue function and adding/subtracting 1 there is enough (you could use ++ and -- on the variable _data directly, but you need to be sure you're handling it properly). assuming all else is correct, change your setValue calls to do as mentioned
Code:
$gameVariables.setValue(3, $gameVariables.value(3)+1);
also...
I've moved this thread to Javascript/Plugin Support. Thank you.
